argsort_tie_breaking.note: np.argsort(-np.abs(x))[:k] with default kind='quicksort' is not stable. For a given cell, if the k-th and (k+1)-th absolute values are equal, the token set is implementation-defined. Across two IDENTICAL input runs the result is deterministic within a single process, but minor perturbations to a single gene can non-deterministically rearrange ties among OTHER genes.
